packages.name: driftwm-deps
packages.description: Dependências de sistema necessárias para compilar o DriftWM (compositor Wayland).
packages.installer-cmd: sudo apt install -y libseat-dev libdisplay-info-dev libinput-dev libudev-dev libgbm-dev libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev

packages.name: rustup
packages.description: Instalador e gerenciador de versões do Rust (necessário Rust 1.88+ para o DriftWM; o apt do Ubuntu 24.04 instala versão antiga demais).

packages.name: driftwm
packages.description: DriftWM: compositor Wayland de canvas infinito. Compilado do source.
packages.installer-cmd: git clone https://github.com/malbiruk/driftwm.git /tmp/driftwm && $HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo build --release --manifest-path /tmp/driftwm/Cargo.toml && sudo make -C /tmp/driftwm install

packages.name: xwayland-satellite-deps
packages.description: Dependências de sistema para compilar o xwayland-satellite.
packages.installer-cmd: sudo apt install -y libxcb-cursor-dev clang libclang-dev

packages.name: xwayland-satellite
packages.description: Suporte a apps X11 no DriftWM (dependência opcional, mas recomendada).
